name: ucampus-readiness
description: UCampus 自动化环境就绪检查 — CDP 浏览器 / 技能文件 / 代理三项（🔴 不含任何账号操作）

governance.pii_policy: strict — 凭据/账号操作永不进入此 workflow

steps.name: ucampus-env-readiness
steps.intent: u校园 课程 自动化 环境 就绪 浏览器
steps.action: R=0; systemctl --user is-active hermes-chrome-cdp.service >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'cdp-service: active' || { echo 'cdp-service: inactive (按需启动)'; }; for s in u-campus/ucampus-auto-complete u-campus-course-automation; do test -f ~/.hermes/skills/$s/SKILL.md && echo "skill $(basename $s): ok" || { echo "skill $(basename $s): MISSING"; R=1; }; done; timeout 5 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/7897' 2>/dev/null && echo 'proxy 7897: reachable' || echo 'proxy 7897: down (非关键)'; exit $R
